status: Memory and RV-3028-C8 archive coverage verified. LIS2DW12 documentation is tracked separately in the catalog.
coverage_notes: Winbond W25Q128JVPIQ exact part in Rev M PDF p77. Q option means QE=1 fixed (PDF p76), not writable configuration default. For IM/M-DTR reference a different document.
Winbond repeated power-cycle requirements: section 9.3.1 PDF p63; CS must track VCC during ramp.

MX30LF2G18AC-TI: -T is 48-TSOP, -I industrial -40 to +85 C, exact table PDF p8. Needs 4-bit ECC per (512+16)B (PDF p7). PM2386 v1.5 belongs J-grade; PM2129 v1.4 is archived exact industrial reference.
Macronix manufacturer recommends MX30LF2G28AD as successor; 8-bit ECC and spare-area geometry differ. AN0719 is reference only; no substitution made.

RTC uses exact C8 package docs, not C7. Backup switching disabled on delivery (manual PDF p46); CLKOUT initially enabled; EEPROM configuration procedure matters for permanent behavior (manual sections 4.6,7). Non-rechargeable source must not have trickle charger enabled.
AN0340 and AN0363 explain interrupted NAND program/erase and recovery. AN0271/0278/0289/0339/0545 cover ECC, bad blocks, wear, retention and design-in.
